 // Bugs with the {notable} attribute show up in the "What's Changed" box on the download page.
 //* Wireshark contains traces of nuts. What kind of nuts? The kind you're allergic to. wsbuglink:5000[] {notable}
 
+* Wireshark appears in German when the system language is Dutch. wsbuglink:20347[].
+* Qt: Capture filter combo box does not enforce minimum size or expanding size policy. wsbuglink:21080[].
+* BACapp: Error parsing you-are request. wsbuglink:21260[].
+* Use-After-Free in Ethernet POWERLINK (EPL) Dissector during profile loading error path. wsbuglink:21267[].
+* Sponsor slides are not properly shown. wsbuglink:21268[].
+* Buffer overlow/segfault in Catapult DCT2000 dissector via not check no_ddi_entries in header. wsbuglink:21270[].
+* Fuzz job issue: fuzz-2026-05-24-14517548985.pcap. wsbuglink:21272[].
+* Fuzz job UTF-8 encoding issue: fuzz-2026-06-07-14732586286.pcap. wsbuglink:21331[].
+* Memory leak in alp-sample1.pcap. wsbuglink:21343[].
+* Memory leak in nspi.pcap. wsbuglink:21344[].
+* Heap-Buffer-Overflow in Wireshark Logcat Parser. wsbuglink:21346[].
+* IPv6 Ping from Debian (among others) is dissected as "HiPerConTracer" wsbuglink:21349[].
+* HEVC (H.265) dissector: bit_offset not advanced after sub_layer_hrd_parameters() causes false Malformed Packet. wsbuglink:21362[].
+* dfilter_compile_full: heap-buffer-overflow READ in ws_strptime on a time literal. wsbuglink:21376[].
+* Wireshark crashes with a HEAP_CORRUPTION error when using the last saved recent_common file. wsbuglink:21379[].
+* Fuzz job issue: fuzz-2026-06-30-15106674620.pcap. wsbuglink:21381[].
